about_the_game:
Reserqution - an immersive action-adventure single-player third-person game set in a post-apocalyptic atmospheric soviet cyberpunk world.

As a teenage hacker armed with the revolutionary Flipper Zero device you'll navigate through a dystopian landscape where artificial intelligence has seized control, and human consciousness has become a precious resource. 

Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative with a unique blend of stealth-action, and survival gameplay where the fate of human consciousness hangs by a thread. Interact with diverse characters, uncover dark secrets, and make decisions to shape the future in the fight against the AI dictatorship as you navigate the trials toward your ultimate enemy.

About the game narrative:

In 2045, in the darkness of a nuclear explosion that devastated Eastern Europe, where technology became the key weapon, a new war for intellectual resources began.

In the chaos, an experimental neural network was created. Its core was based on the mind of a cruel dictator who seeks immortality to maintain power at any cost and enslave the population by extracting neural matter from human brains.

The protagonist Arthur is a young man who has lost his family, home, and childhood. The only thing he has left is a gift from his father that will change his destiny.

It's an AI-based device prototype capable of fulfilling any wish, but the only thing Arthur's heart desires is to stop the war.

Core gameplay:

🔹 PARKOUR THROUGH A CYBERPUNK WASTELAND

Navigate through an atmospheric detailed post-apocalyptic soviet world using fluid parkour mechanics. Scale buildings, traverse rooftops, and discover hidden paths in your quest for survival.

🔹 MASTER THE ART OF HACKING

Utilize your Flipper Zero device to hack into enemy systems, override security protocols, and turn the machines against their masters. Every hack brings you closer to uncovering the truth about your father's disappearance.

🔹 STEALTH AND SURVIVAL

Choose your approach carefully - engage in strategic stealth tactic gameplay to avoid detection or face the consequences of confrontation. Every decision shapes your journey through this unforgiving world.

Gameplay Features:

🔹 BECOME A MASTER HACKER

  • Take control of drones and turn machines against their masters

  • Each successful hack brings you closer to solving your father's disappearance

🔹 EXPLORE THE CYBER-WASTELAND

  • Conquer abandoned buildings, rooftops and discover secret paths

  • Use the environment and shadows to stay hidden from prying eyes

🔹 CHOOSE YOUR PATH

  • Move stealthily or engage in confrontation

  • Use non-lethal weapons and tactical gadgets in combat

🔹 DEVELOP YOUR SKILLS

  • Upgrade your equipment and unlock new capabilities

  • Master advanced hacking and parkour techniques

🔹 IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE ATMOSPHERE

  • Explore post-apocalyptic Soviet cyberpunk

  • Interact with unique characters

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat scenes that feature violence and gore. Dialogue and cutscenes contain strong language. Includes references to alcohol, tobacco use, and crude/mature humor.
